title: Compact-support comparison with completed and condensed coefficient realization
statement:
Let $k$ be a field of positive prime characteristic $p$, let $\ell\ne p$ be prime, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a $k$-morphism of separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Fix a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R$ and uniformizer $t$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Fix a compactification $c=(X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{g}Y)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. For $n\geq1$ and $T=X,\overline X,Y$, set $A_{n,T}=(R/t^n)_T$, $\widehat R_T=\lim_n A_{n,T}$, and let $\mathcal I_T(R)$ be the completed integral category of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete]. Use the strict reduction functor $\mathcal R_T$, the semilinear system category $\mathscr S_T$, and $\mathcal L_T=R\lim U_T$ of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Let $F_n=Rg_{*,n}j_!$. Let $\mathcal F$ denote its functor on normalized coefficient systems, with the canonical projection comparisons. Define
$$P_RK=R\lim\mathcal T_f^c(K),$$
where $\mathcal T_f^c$ is the actual strict compact-support reduction-tower functor of [lem-weil-compact-support-reduction-tower-functor], with its semilinear lift given by the geometric models of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections].

Then $P_R$ is an exact $R$-linear functor $\mathcal I_X(R)\to\mathcal I_Y(R)$. There is a specified natural isomorphism of normalized derived semilinear systems
$$\alpha_K:\mathcal R_Y(P_RK)\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal F(\mathcal R_XK).$$
Its evaluation is the canonical map $(P_RK)\otimes^L_{\widehat R_Y}A_{n,Y}\to F_n(K\otimes^L_{\widehat R_X}A_{n,X})$ induced by the total-limit projections. In particular this comparison includes transitions and all coefficient coherences, rather than only its evaluations.

Let $J_T:\mathcal I_T(R)[1/t]\simeq\mathcal C_E^c(T)$ be the derived coefficient-extension equivalence of [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-e-realization]. For the coefficient ring $E_{\overline X}^c$, let $j_{!,E}$ be sheafification of the extension-by-zero module presheaf on the open slice site, applied termwise to complexes [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact]. Let $Rg_{*,E}$ be the derived direct image with the coefficient action and pullback identification of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. Put $P_E^c=Rg_{*,E}j_{!,E}$ on those condensed module-object categories, and use the identical composite to define $P_\Omega^c$ for the finite-extension-valued coefficient ring $\Omega_T^c$ of [prop-weil-pbc-qbar-condensed-two-colimit], $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. These composites preserve the indicated bounded constructible categories. There is a natural isomorphism
$$a_{f,E,K}:J_Y((P_RK)[1/t])\xrightarrow{\sim}P_E^cJ_X(K[1/t]).$$
For finite $E\subset F\subset\Omega$ and also for $F=\Omega$, put $T_{E,F}^T=F_T^c\otimes^L_{E_T^c}-$ (with $F_T^c=\Omega_T^c$ in the latter case). The canonical coefficient projection comparison is an isomorphism
$$T_{E,F}^YP_E^c\xrightarrow{\sim}P_F^cT_{E,F}^X.$$
For finite $F/E$, write $K_S$ for completed integral scalar extension to $S=\mathcal O_F$ [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. There is a canonical comparison $(P_RK)_S\simeq P_SK_S$, compatible with $\alpha$, $a$, and the preceding condensed projection comparison after rationalization. All these specified comparisons preserve morphisms, shifts, identities, towers of finite coefficient extensions and compactification-refinement maps, with their composition coherences. This is a comparison of compact-support functors only; it makes no assertion about their right adjoints.
